providers.reason: Fenice can reach the authorized Directa/Darwin API path, but the separate realtime/historical datafeed entitlement is not enabled. Exact-MIC realtime evidence is therefore not available from Directa today.

Official EU WebSockets provide realtime European trades/quotes sourced from Cboe Europe across 18 markets. Useful as an independent realtime cross-check, but not exact primary-MIC evidence for Xetra/Milan/Euronext listings.
Cboe Europe offers realtime top-of-book/depth feeds, pan-European coverage and free trials. Production PAPER admission still requires lawful feed entitlement and exact Cboe venue/instrument mapping.
dxFeed offers realtime EU equities and exchange-sourced feeds including Cboe Europe, gettex and Tradegate. PAPER requires commercial entitlement and exact source/venue mapping.
IBKR Web API supports streaming Level 1 data and exchange-specific conId@EXCHANGE requests. Most securities require market-data subscriptions and no authorized IBKR account is connected to Fenice.
Saxo OpenAPI supports realtime streaming quotes, but market-data access requires an authorized account/token and applicable data terms.
Deutsche Boerse distributes Xetra realtime data through CEF direct feeds and data vendors. Exact XETR evidence is attractive but requires applicable data entitlement/non-display terms.
Euronext realtime data is available by direct feed or redistributor under EMDA/EDSA/subscriber terms. Exact venue data can be PAPER-eligible only after entitlement is documented.
International realtime stock quotes require separately verified enterprise market-data entitlement; no such entitlement is persisted in Fenice.
Free service is end-of-day and current public intraday positioning does not establish exact-venue international realtime entitlement for Fenice.
Public cross-check only; never satisfies PAPER quorum.
